description: The file contains C source code implementing cryptographic and compression functions, including functions related to compression algorithms like deflate, zlib, gzip, and conditional support for LZS via external functions. It also includes license headers, module descriptions, and function implementations for compression operations within a networking system.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCryptoCompress(ULONG algorithm,PVOID plain,ULONG size,PVOID compact,PULONG pOutSize,ULONG mode,ULONG flag)
methods.description: Performs cryptography compression based on specified algorithm, dispatching to appropriate internal functions.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCryptoOutCompress(PVOID plain,ULONG size,PVOID compact,PULONG pOutSize,ULONG mode,ULONG flag)
methods.description: Stub function for output compression, currently returns the input size.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCryptoDeflateCompress(PVOID plain,ULONG size,PVOID compact,PULONG pOutSize,ULONG mode,ULONG flag)
methods.description: Stub function for deflate compression, returns input size.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCryptoLzsCompress(PVOID plain,ULONG size,PVOID compact,PULONG pOutSize,ULONG mode,ULONG flag)
methods.description: Performs LZS compression with dynamic memory allocation and external LZS functions if enabled.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCryptoV42bisCompress(PVOID plain,ULONG size,PVOID compact,PULONG pOutSize,ULONG mode,ULONG flag)
methods.description: Stub function for V42bis compression, returns input size.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCryptoZlibCompress(PVOID plain,ULONG size,PVOID compact,PULONG pOutSize)
methods.description: Uses zlib's compress function to perform compression if available.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCryptoGzipCompress(PVOID plain,ULONG size,PVOID compact,PULONG pOutSize)
methods.description: Uses internal gzip compression if enabled; otherwise, logs a warning.
